quadrant.comment: Read the exact quadrantChart prefix before entering its body; a following statement may touch the header. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and quadrant.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read point styles after the coordinate list, keeping directives in their opening gap. An empty description block after the coordinates starts a following statement. Follows quadrant.md#points, common.md#comment-lines, and quadrant.md#empty-description-blocks.

Read a local description block with case-insensitive keyword and Notation whitespace, keeping inline percent pairs as text. A closed empty block can also follow any completed statement unit. Its opening line is sufficient to enter the context when a comment or blank line precedes the closer. Follows quadrant.md#accessibility-values, common.md#comment-lines, quadrant.md#empty-description-blocks, and quadrant.md#the-statement-context.
Read a description text run, stopping before a common comment or the closing brace. Follows quadrant.md#accessibility-values and common.md#comment-lines.

Read an accessibility keyword and its colon at a statement-context unit start, including after a semicolon. Whitespace around the colon follows Notation, and inline percent pairs remain value text. Follows quadrant.md#the-statement-context, quadrant.md#accessibility-values, quadrant.md#diagram-and-statements, and common.md#comment-lines.
Read a bounded title and its remaining line, including punctuation and percent pairs. Follows quadrant.md#the-title-context, common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary, and common.md#comment-lines.

Read a class definition's element name and its properties, with exactly one diagram whitespace character on each side of the name. A terminal empty description block is a following statement. Follows quadrant.md#classes, common.md#comment-lines, and quadrant.md#empty-description-blocks.
Read axis and quadrant keywords, including a keyword touching its text. Follows quadrant.md#the-statement-context.
patterns.name: keyword.control.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read an axis arrow as one relation operator. Follows quadrant.md#axes.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.arrow.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the shared HTML tag reader for converted attribute quotes. Follows common.md#html-attribute-quotes.
Read an entity as label text, preserving its directives. Follows quadrant.md#units-and-contexts.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the shared markdown delimiter reader; invalid interior quotes and backquotes are not validated. Follows quadrant.md#strings.
Read a double-quoted quadrant label without backslash escapes. Follows quadrant.md#strings.
Read a class selector as a separator and an element name. Follows quadrant.md#the-class-name-context.
Read the point's colon and coordinate-list brackets. Follows quadrant.md#the-point-context.
Read a coordinate as one numeric text unit, including its internal directives. Follows quadrant.md#the-point-context and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the separator between coordinates. Follows quadrant.md#the-point-context.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.separator.comma.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows quadrant.md#comments.
Read a semicolon as a statement separator. Follows quadrant.md#diagram-and-statements.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.separator.semicolon.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read unquoted axis, quadrant and point labels while preserving maximal word runs through directives. Follows quadrant.md#texts, quadrant.md#the-statement-context, and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

quadrant-style-separators.comment: Read the property colon and style-list comma outside values. Follows quadrant.md#points and quadrant.md#rejections-outside-the-grammar.

quadrant-style.comment: Read one whole style property value, leaving trailing whitespace outside its scope. A following empty description block ends the property value. Follows quadrant.md#rejections-outside-the-grammar, common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary, common.md#comment-lines, and quadrant.md#empty-description-blocks.

quadrant-line-final-keywords.comment: Read a reserved keyword at a statement start when only padding and directives follow on its physical line. A value on a later line receives the surrounding context's scopes. Follows quadrant.md#accessibility-values and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
